profileChanges.old: Ein Punkt startet bei (1|0) und bewegt sich mit zunehmendem Parameter t im Uhrzeigersinn. Bestimme seine x- und y-Koordinatenfunktionen und erkläre, welche der Grundgraphen unverändert bleibt und welcher gespiegelt wird.
profileChanges.new: Ein Punkt startet auf dem Einheitskreis bei (1|0). Der Parameter t≥0 bezeichnet den ab dem Start im Uhrzeigersinn zurückgelegten Winkel im Bogenmaß. Bestimme seine x- und y-Koordinatenfunktionen und erkläre, welcher der Grundgraphen unverändert bleibt und welcher gespiegelt wird.

profileChanges.old: A point starts at (1,0) and moves clockwise as parameter t increases. Determine its x- and y-coordinate functions and explain which base graph stays unchanged and which is reflected.
profileChanges.new: A point starts at (1,0) on the unit circle. The parameter t≥0 is the angle swept clockwise from the starting position, measured in radians. Determine its x- and y-coordinate functions and explain which of the base graphs stays unchanged and which is reflected.

mathematicalReview.correctedParameter: t>=0 is the swept clockwise angle in radians, not elapsed time. With the usual counterclockwise signed angle alpha, alpha=-t modulo full turns.
mathematicalReview.coordinates: x(t)=cos(-t)=cos(t), y(t)=sin(-t)=-sin(t). Cosine remains unchanged and sine is reflected across the horizontal axis.
mathematicalReview.oldCounterexample: theta=-2t swept angle is2t, so it violates the revised definition except at isolated coincident positions; at t=pi/2 it gives(-1,0), not the required(0,-1).
mathematicalReview.noSpeedRequirement: No clock, angular speed, derivative or law relating angle to time is requested or needed. The angle itself is the independent variable.
mathematicalReview.otherCases: The five standard coordinate pairs and the quarter-turn start identity sin(t+pi/2)=cos(t) remain correct. All expectations, coverage settings, three demonstrations, variation axes, expected-performance and understanding-focus fields are identical.
mathematicalReview.independence: The learner must generate the coordinate traces and justify the orientation/phase changes; copying the unchanged teaching image alone does not meet the complete profile.
